title: Split and play
one: Shelf's bookmark cut twice: the halves make a pause, and the left tail a play.
idea: Shelf's bookmark cut twice, with nothing stamped on: a slot down the middle makes the two halves a pause, and the notch's right edge, carried on across the left half, turns the left tail into a play pointing into the gap. Its height is exactly three plays, facing right, left and right, as your designer friend suggested.
built: The notch is at 30 degrees, so the plays the two cuts' angles make up the left half are equilateral, and the bookmark is exactly three of them tall, interlocked: four notch depths, 1.15 times its width (today's bookmark is 1.24). Drawn 43.5 × 50.23 dp and shown at 90% about the canvas centre, 39.15 × 45.21 dp of the 72 the launcher shows, as every option is. The slot is 1/7 of the width, 6.21 dp; the diagonal is 0.8 of that, 4.97 dp measured square to itself, which makes the play 8% taller than two equal cuts would without changing the height. The play is 19.37 × 16.78 dp before scaling, 0.39 of the height, and its tip stops 1.86 dp short of the slot. Corners follow what made them: the outline's square shoulders take 4/34 of the width, every corner a cut makes takes the tips' 1.5/34.
corners: A corner's radius follows what made it. The outline's square shoulders take 4/34 of the width; every corner a cut makes (the tips, the slot's corners, the diagonal's and the play's) takes the tips' 1.5/34. In the pixel cuts every cut corner is sharp.
small: 48 px: a 28 × 32 px bookmark with an 8 px notch, so four notch depths are the height and the three plays land on whole pixels; a 4 px slot (1/7) and a diagonal dropped 4 px, 3.47 px square to itself. The play is 12 px tall, its axis on a pixel boundary so its edges rasterise alike, and its tip stops 1.5 px short of the slot. 32 px: 21 × 24 px with a 6 px notch (four depths again) and a 3 px slot; the play is 9 × 7.88 px with its tip 1.13 px short of the slot; like C's, this cut sits half a pixel left of the tile's centre, because a 3 px slot needs an odd-width bookmark. 16 px: the split alone, 9 × 10 px with a 1 px slot and 45 degree stairs for feet: a 3 px play here turned into a nick in the bar at real size. Glyph: the plain bookmark on D's proportions, 16 × 18 px, since a play and pause glyph would sit beside the media card's real play and pause button. The pixel cuts keep their size; only the launcher drawing is shown at 90%. The extension's toolbar button is the plain bookmark at 16 and 32 px (10 × 12 and 20 × 24 px, each four notch depths tall), because the extension only saves and the split reads as a pause control there; the browser tab, the launcher and everything from 48 px up show D.
risks: A play with a pause is the media toggle, so it can read as a player's control or a music app before a reading app, most of all in the light colourway. The reviewer with no context saw the earlier D as play and pause controls with the left bar snapped off. The left half's lower edge and the right half's foot run as one line from top left to bottom right, the direction of the "off" slash, though the slot breaks it. The notch is 3 degrees shallower than today's bookmark, and D's bookmark is 6.5% shorter than the one A, B and C share. The play shows only from 32 px up, and with the bigger play its tip comes within about a pixel of the slot at 32 px. The mark is three pieces, so any one-colour use has to keep both cuts open.
